title: Memev contribution, version 1: the signature and admission block
description: The block that a contribution carries in the extension block of the operation envelope (docs/OPERATION-ENVELOPE.md), under the key `contribution`. It is not a second envelope: the schema version, the causal context, the operation id and the content hash are the envelope's own. The validator is src/engine/federation/contribution.mjs; the admission is src/engine/federation/admission.mjs. Planned: see docs/FEDERATION.md.

subject.description: The subject that wrote it. It is the origin identity of the envelope.

scope.description: The scope it is written for, one of the scope types of docs/IDENTITY-AND-SCOPES.md.

classification.description: A label. The classification schema of SO-F-05 constrains its values later; until then any non-empty string is accepted by the validator, and the node's policy lists the labels it accepts.

sequence.description: The sequence, held per sender and scope. The node refuses a sequence that is not above the high-water mark of a sender and scope, which it keeps in its own operation log.

payload_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the canonical text of the envelope payload.

derived_from.description: Operation ids this was derived from, sorted, without repeats.

signature.description: Made with the role key through ssh-keygen, over the text that src/engine/federation/contribution.mjs names, in a namespace of its own. A signature made for a role binding (namespace memev) is not valid here.

principal.description: The id of the subject's key that signed.
